[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to improve overall fitness.

[CHANGE] User wants to incorporate more strength training into their routine.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a list of bodyweight exercises for home: push-ups, squats, lunges, planks, dumbbell rows, burpees, mountain climbers.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested starting with 2-3 strength training sessions a week and gradually increasing frequency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended starting with lighter weights and higher reps (12-15) to build endurance, then progressing to heavier weights and lower reps (8-10) for strength gains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized the importance of proper form and technique to avoid injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised warming up with 5-10 minutes of cardio and stretching before strength training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested mixing and matching exercises to keep workouts interesting and prevent plateaus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended considering working with a personal trainer or fitness coach for a customized workout plan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reminded the user to listen to their body and rest when needed.  
[PREFERENCE] User noticed a big difference in their core strength after attending a yoga workshop a few weeks ago.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided exercises to target core strength, balance, and flexibility: plank, tree pose, single-leg deadlifts, side plank, bird dog.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant listed resistance band or dumbbell exercises: Russian twists, Pallof press, lateral walks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised engaging core muscles before starting any exercise and focusing on slow, controlled movements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended practicing core exercises 2-3 times a week with rest days in between.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested incorporating dynamic movements for balance and flexibility improvement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised listening to the body and stopping any exercise that causes discomfort or pain.
